Options:
A. Kevin
B. Marcus
C. Diane
D. Tanya

[1] (about=GROUP, said_by=Tanya, group-interaction, t4 @2026-01-25T14:38:00) Saturday plan: no fixed alarm, walk when ready, grill on by noon, main meal by 2.
[2] (about=GROUP, said_by=Diane, group-interaction, t3 @2026-01-25T14:30:00) Diane proposes weekend of February 14th for visit to Loretta; asks Marcus if he can come that weekend, and suggests keeping Kevin in loop even if he can't make it.
[3] (about=GROUP, said_by=Diane, group-interaction, t14 @2026-03-01T16:13:00) April 11 visit confirmed: Kevin flights confirmed, Marcus bringing grill, Diane bringing wine and dessert, guest room ready.
[4] (about=GROUP, said_by=Loretta, group-insight, t12 @2026-02-22T14:58:00) Loretta says the chat is like Sunday dinner, not the doctor's office.
[5] (about=Marcus, core, t0 @2026-01-11T16:02:00) Planning to come Saturday to fix kitchen faucet and possibly gutter.
[6] (about=Marcus, said_by=Loretta, profile, t0 @2026-01-11T16:02:00) Loretta says Marcus always gets home-cooked meal when he visits.
[7] (about=Marcus, said_by=Diane, profile, t10 @2026-02-15T16:47:00) Diane notes that Marcus's view has been that Loretta manages fine, but Tuesday was a different kind of moment.
[8] (about=Marcus, core, t8 @2026-02-08T15:22:00) Marcus prefers calls on Thursdays after 5 PM.
agent_answer:
Marcus’s response signaled that his actual preference was the home-cooked / at-home meal rather than going out. The evidence is that Loretta says Marcus always gets a home-cooked meal when he visits, and the at-home plan had Marcus bringing the grill.

So the answer is: **B. Marcus**.
